scope: Sensitivity-first alpha wake-engine selection on the standalone Waveshare ESP32-S3 audio board
alphaDecision: Ship the more sensitive detector for the alpha and accept poor hard-negative performance while retaining the original production gate.
limitations: The detector has a high measured false-activation rate on the generated negative corpus.
The final five-case confirmation used computer-generated speech in one bench arrangement.
Public-model redistribution licensing has not been established.
No representative human/noisy-room corpus or one-hour false-wake measurement has passed.
